description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome back to the market this three bedroom upper flat on Cartington Terrace, Heaton.

The property comprises an entrance hallway with stairs leading to the first floor, a welcoming lounge, a separate kitchen, a bathroom and three generously sized double bedrooms.

Ideally situated close to Chillingham Road, the property benefits from easy access to a wide range of local shops, restaurants and cafés, as well as excellent transport links into Newcastle City Centre. Offering practical living space in a convenient location.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
